༄༅/ /rje btsun seng ge sgra'i bsgom zlas bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun seng ge sgra'i bsgom zlas bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ rje btsun seng ge sgra mdun du bsgom la/ mchod pa dang bstod pa byas te/ rang lhar gsal ba yang thugs kar thim/ gzungs gtso bor gyur pa'i sngags bzlas shing*/ dmigs pa/ tri shul rgya mtshor sdigs pas rgya mtsho bdun rnam pa brgyar g.yos/ klu'i gnas dang*/ bdud kyi gnas thams cad du/ cha lang gi sgra lta bu'i deng 'ur sngags kyi sgra klad pa 'gas pa lta bur dwangangs nas gnod sems dor te/ klu sheṣa klu brgyad dang bcas pa sbrul chen po'i rang gzugs kyis gus pas btud nas/ /sheṣa tri shul las bkris/ gzhan rnams phyogs mtshams su 'khaud pa'i mchod pa byed pa la chos ston pa dang*/ snying ga'i sngags kyi 'od kyis sdug bsngal kun zhi bar bsam la/ snying rje dang bdag gzhan brje ba yun ring du bsgom/ nyal ba'i tshe klu dgu rang gnas su song*/ stong nyid yun ring du bsgoms nas so/ /snying po 'bum phra ma mtha'ang song ba zhig la 'di yid ches zab pa ste/ gleng gzhi'i nyams len zhal rgyun zhal nas brgyud pa'i man ngag zhig go/ // dge slong tā ra nā thas bris// dge'o// ༄༅/ /rje btsun seng ge sgra'i bstod pa bzhugs/ ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin sku/ /chos sku ro gcig nam mkha' mnyam/ / legs ldan drang srong gzugs 'dzin pa/ /smon lam rgya mtsho 'gro ba yis/ / gdung sel khyod ni na gend+ra/ /phyugs bdag chen po'i bla ma kyai/ /'gro la rtag tu phan dgongs pa'i/ /'byung po'i mgon po khyed la 'dud/ /snang ba'i lus can rje btsun khyod/ /'gro ba'i mgon po chos sku lags/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dngos grub mtsho/ /gnod las skyob mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mdung rtse gsum pa khyod kyi sku/ /'jig rten gsum na 'di nyid 'jigs/ /klu chen bsrubs pa'i bcud ldan pa'i/ /thod pa 'dzin khyod drag po'o/ /'jigs byed ri dwags pags pa can/ /nṛ gā'i tshangs skud spyan gsum ldan/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bshes gnyen khyod/

/zhi ba sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid/ /bdag ni khyod la gsol 'debs na/ /nor rgyas slob ma sa 'dzin dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang sbyin byed skyes/ /gnod sbyin ro langs rig sngags dang*/ /'byung po gshin rje kun las skyob/ /sman ljongs nyams nga'i 'brog dgon du/ /bag med nyal sogs dus kun tu/ /rje btsun khyod kyis bsrungs pa dang*/ nam yang dge legs dngos grub stsol/ / 'di rje btsun mkha' spyod seng ge sgra la bstod pa kun dga' snying pos snar thang du bris// zhu dag/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ - PAGE 114 - PAGE - PAGE 113 -
